notes: Examined `deployDate = block.timestamp;`. The value is stored as the contract's deployment instant and is afterwards read only as one side of a deadline comparison (line 136). A block producer can shift it by seconds, which shifts the recorded deployment instant by seconds -- that is what a deployment instant is. Nothing derives a selection, an ordering or an identifier from it, so it is not used as though unpredictable. Not an instance of insecure_randomness at this location. This says nothing about the rest of the file.
